results.content: # Bayesian Optimization of XGBoost Hyperparameters with scikit-optimize. Bayesian optimization is an efficient alternative to grid search for finding optimal hyperparameters in XGBoost. Unlike grid search, which exhaustively evaluates all combinations of hyperparameters, Bayesian optimization intelligently selects the next set of hyperparameters to evaluate based on the results of previous evaluations. Scikit-optimize provides an easy-to-use implementation of Bayesian optimization that integrates seamlessly with scikit-learn’s API. We can then use use Bayesian optimization to search XGBoost hyperparameters with the `BayesSearchCV` class. 1.
